policy: DE*VIR is a shared Virta technical/network prefix. Never apply 0.29 EUR/kWh to the full DE*VIR namespace. V-Markt officially publishes 0.29 EUR/kWh for its AC charging points when using the Virta app or Virta RFID and states that operative charging management is provided by Virta International GmbH. Other cards/providers can have different prices. Rank this evidence only for exact V-Markt EVSE matches listed here; ad-hoc/one-time prices remain unresolved and are not inferred.
